title: Oozy Tangy Filipino Linguine Pasta Pinakbet
description: A tangy and chewy Filipino dish featuring linguine pasta, inspired by the traditional pinakbet recipe, served in a ramekin and perfect for a hangover cure.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cook the linguine pasta according to package instructions until al dente.
In a large skillet, heat the tomato sauce over medium heat.
Add the pre-cooked tandoor chicken, bitter melon, eggplant, and okra to the skillet and stir to combine.
Season the mixture with fish sauce and calamansi juice.
Combine the cooked linguine pasta and the vegetable mixture in a large bowl.
Transfer the pasta mixture to a ramekin and top with additional tomato sauce if desired.
Bake the pinakbet in the preheated oven for 10 minutes or until the sauce is bubbly.
Remove the pinakbet from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
